func_0203ad84 at 0x0203ad84 closes the run: a string-copy helper on unrelated globals (data_020994d4, data_020a0d90) with no PathPtr receiver, folded in under its func_ name the same way dBgPi kept its neighbouring shards.
Preceded by the dM3dGSph member run ending at C2 0x0203ac70..0x0203ac80; followed by DecIfAbove0_Short's math family. The span is the whole class.
PathPtr is non-polymorphic: no _ZTS/_ZTI/_ZTV for it exists in the ROM, so this is a text-only fold with no data or bss claim.
notes: Six members arrived as anonymous func_ shards; symbols.txt names them by their member spellings. GetPullFactor reads def->flags & 0x7f -- the low seven bits under Loops' 0x80 closed-path bit -- which path-follow code scales a lateral offset by. GetUnk004 reads the remaining opaque PathDef byte. SetDef is the def-pointer store FromID goes through. SetPathTable/GetNodeTable/SetNodeTable manage the level's PATH_DEFS/PATH_NODES/NUM_PATHS globals (data_020a0d84/88/8c, bss gap-served, no claim) that LoadPathObjects and LoadPathNodeObjects load; they are statics on the class because GetNode calls GetNodeTable as its own plumbing.
mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order, so the file lists C1 first and FromID last; the manifest ordinals run ROM-ascending.
